For a single-phase one-pulse controlled rectifier with counter EMF \( E \) and source voltage \( V_m \sin(\omega t) \), conduction begins when \( V_m \sin(\omega t) \ge E \).  

Given:  
\( V_m = 400 \, \text{V} \)  
\( E = 200 \, \text{V} \)  

The condition for thyristor firing is:  
\[
400 \sin\theta \ge 200
\]
\[
\sin\theta \ge 0.5
\]
\[
\theta \ge 30^\circ \quad \text{and} \quad \theta \le 150^\circ
\]
where \( \theta = \omega t \) is the firing angle measured from the zero-crossing of the source voltage.  

Thus the firing angle range is \( 30^\circ \) to \( 150^\circ \).  

Final answer: (A)
